name: B10-0374/2025 (Renew) – Gaza at breaking point: EU action to combat famine and the urgent need to release hostages and move towards a two-state solution
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Gaza at breaking point: EU action to combat famine, the urgent need to release hostages and move towards a two-state solution
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for an immediate and permanent ceasefire in Gaza and for food, medicine and other aid to reach people without obstruction. It asks the European Union to suspend the trade part of its agreement with Israel until grave violations of international law stop, and to sanction two Israeli ministers and violent settlers. It also calls for all hostages held by Hamas to be released and for European countries to recognise the State of Palestine once hostages are freed and Hamas has no future role in Gaza.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. These are requests to the EU Council, Commission and member states, not decisions.
- **Who it affects:** Israel, the Palestinian Authority, Hamas, EU member states and people in Gaza.
- **What happens next:** EU governments and the Commission decide whether to act on the requests.
